subject: Biology
title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants - DPP 03 (Pistil, Megasporogenesis & Embryo Sac)

questions.question: Part of pistil which serve as landing platform for male gametophyte is-
The placenta is located.......
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: inside the ovarian cavity..

questions.question: Mark the incorrectly matched.
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Single pistil - Syncarpous.

questions.question: The ovule of an angiosperm is technically equivalent to
Which of the following group of structure located inside ovary-
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: nucellus, locule and megasporangium.

questions.question: Which of the following sequence of development of embryo sac/ female gametophyte is correct?
options: Nucellus - Megaspore mother cell - Megaspore - embryo sac.
questions.explanation: Option (B) is correct: Nucellus - Megaspore mother cell - Megaspore - embryo sac..

questions.question: Megaspore mother cell differentiate in.................. region from nucellus.
Statement I: The megaspore mother cell undergoes megasporogenesis to form 4 megaspores. Statement II: Megaspore mother cells and megaspores both are diploid.
questions.explanation: Option (C) is correct: Only statement I is correct.

questions.question: Embryo sac is monosporic when it develops from:
options: one of the four megaspores of a megaspore mother cell.
the megaspore mother cell where meiosis has occurred but cytokinesis does not take place.
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: one of the four megaspores of a megaspore mother cell..

questions.question: The largest cell in an embryo sac is;
How many nuclei are found in female gametophyte?
How many cells are found in female gametophyte?
Hilum is known as
options: a place where ovule fuses with funicle.
a place where ovule attached to the placenta.
questions.explanation: Option (A) is correct: a place where ovule fuses with funicle..
